subject: Draft MAP: privacy & evidence milestones — confirmation and next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Ruiz <aruiz@medintel.com>, Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@healthsync.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (data handling milestone)

Alexandra / Oliver — thanks again for the time earlier. Leaving this thread with the post-call recap and a focused draft of the Mutual Action Plan (attached) for the Data Handling & Compliance milestone. High level: we captured your constraints on PHI/PII, retention windows, and audit capabilities; below are the items we need to lock down to finalize commercial terms.

Key ask: please confirm owner for each acceptance item and whether anything is missing so we can lock the target close date.

Proposed MAP milestone — Data Handling & Evidence (owner suggestions in parentheses):
- Retention policy: 7 years for PHI records, 2 years for non-PHI logs (Owner: MedIntel legal)
- System logging & audit trails: append-only audit logs exposed via API and S3 snapshot (Owner: Redwood infra)
- Access controls & KMS: envelope encryption with customer-managed KMS proof (Owner: MedIntel security)
- Data deletion workflow: documented purge process + test plan (Owner: MedIntel ops)
- Evidence & attestations: SOC 2 Type II summary + sample logs + signed checklist (Owner: Redwood compliance)

Dependencies called out on the call:
- Legal review of contract language and retention terms (MedIntel legal)
- Redwood to provide SOC2 summary and sample audit logs (Redwood)
- KMS connectivity test in staging (joint)

Target close date (proposed): 2026-12-15

Attachments: MAP-draft-v2.docx, SOC2-type2-summary.pdf (summary), sample-audit-logs.txt (sanitized)

Next steps I recommend this week:
1) Confirm owners for the five acceptance items above (reply with names)
2) MedIntel legal to flag any retention/legal conflicts by 2026-10-25
3) Redwood to upload SOC2 summary & sample logs by 2026-10-22 (I've attached the initial package)
4) Schedule a 30-min technical run-through on KMS + logging week of 2026-10-26

Thanks — happy to jump on another call if helpful.

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Alexandra Ruiz <aruiz@medintel.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@healthsync.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (data handling milestone)

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap and the draft. A few clarifications from our side after internal review: 

1) PHI constraints: MedIntel is subject to stricter rules — retention for PHI should be "up to 7 years" but only if documented and approved by counsel. We need the ability to request immediate purge on a per-customer basis for specific datasets.
2) KMS: we require customer-managed keys (we run keys in Azure Key Vault). We need a test that proves CMK access WITHOUT Redwood holding plaintext key material.
3) SOC2: a summary is fine up front, but we will require the full SOC 2 Type II report under NDA before production.
4) Audit logs: we want immutable logs with proof of write (hash chaining or similar) and the ability to export to our SIEM.

Action owners: I can own the legal coordination and will loop in counsel; Oliver will be our technical lead for the KMS and logging tests. We'll aim to get legal comments by 2026-10-28.

Can Redwood confirm whether the sample logs you attach are fully sanitized (no PHI) and whether you can provide a short readme describing the log schema?

Best,
Alexandra Ruiz
Head of Product
MedIntel
aruiz@medintel.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alexandra Ruiz <aruiz@medintel.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (data handling milestone)

Alexandra — thanks for the items. Quick clarifications from engineering/compliance on lineage and evidence: 

- Sample logs: we will provide sanitized examples and a short README describing fields, timestamps, and event types (Attachment: sample-audit-logs.txt).
- Immutable proof: we can provide a hash-chaining export and a time-stamped S3 snapshot per your SIEM ingest format; we will document the export steps in the MAP acceptance criteria.
- Retention policy: engineering can support configurable retention per dataset (configurable to a minimum of 30 days up to 7 years); final retention enforcement will be gated by legal signoff.
- KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed keys (Azure Key Vault and AWS KMS). We will schedule a cross-team runbook review and a connectivity test in staging.

Proposed update to owners (to speed closure):
- Retention policy: MedIntel legal (owner) / Redwood engineering (implementer)
- System logging & audit trails: Redwood infra (owner) / MedIntel security (validator)
- KMS connectivity: MedIntel security (owner) / Redwood infra (implementer)
- Data deletion workflow: MedIntel ops (owner) / Redwood engineering (implementer)
- Evidence & attestations: Redwood compliance (owner) / MedIntel legal (validator)

I'll take point on compiling the README and sanitized logs — target upload by 2026-10-22 (today). Putting Marissa on copy for contract language coordination.

Attachments: sample-audit-logs.txt

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: who will provide the sanitized logs + timeline?

Team — quick internal assign: Monica has the README and will upload sanitized logs today. Need confirmation from Rishi whether we can pull a 30-day snapshot and produce the hash-chain export by EOW (2026-10-29). Also need Marissa to prepare a legal redline window — specifically, we should offer "up to 7 years with legal approval" language and an immediate purge SLA for customer requests (propose 48 hours to start deletion workflows).

Rishi — can you confirm infra capacity and whether the sample export will include event hashes and a short schema? If not, what's the gap and ETA to close?

If we have these items by 2026-10-29 we should be able to meet MedIntel's legal comment date and keep the MAP timeline intact.

Thanks,
Jonas

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Ruiz <aruiz@medintel.com>, Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@healthsync.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Agreed MAP items & target close (Data Handling) — next steps checklist

Alexandra / Oliver — following internal work and the uploads Monica shared, summary of agreed items and owners so we can close the MAP milestone. Please reply with any remaining blockers; otherwise we'll treat this as the working agreement and proceed to incorporate into the MSA amendment.

Agreed milestone: Data Handling & Compliance (finalized acceptance criteria)
- Retention: configurable per dataset; default PHI retention set to 7 years. MedIntel legal to approve final retention language. (Owner: MedIntel legal / Implementer: Redwood engineering)
- Immediate purge: Redwood will execute deletion workflows within 48 hours of a verified MedIntel request; verification steps to be defined by counsel. (Owner: MedIntel ops / Implementer: Redwood engineering)
- Audit trails: append-only audit logs, hash-chained exports, and S3 snapshot delivery for SIEM ingestion. (Owner: Redwood infra / Validator: MedIntel security)
- KMS: customer-managed key support validated for Azure Key Vault; connectivity test scheduled during staging window. (Owner: MedIntel security / Implementer: Redwood infra)
- Evidence: Redwood to provide SOC2 Type II summary now and full report under NDA before production; sample-audit-logs.txt provided as sanitized example. (Owner: Redwood compliance)

Target close date: 2026-12-15
Dependencies to achieving target close:
- MedIntel legal signoff on retention & purge language (due 2026-10-28 — acknowledged)
- Full SOC2 report executed under NDA (MedIntel to provide NDA request by 2026-11-19)
- KMS connectivity test completion in staging (joint)

Immediate next steps (owners & dates):
[ ] MedIntel legal: submit redlines (owner: Alexandra) — by 2026-10-28 (received)
[ ] Redwood: upload sanitized logs + README (owner: Monica) — uploaded 2026-10-22 (Attachment: sample-audit-logs.txt)
[ ] Redwood: provide SOC2 summary (owner: Redwood compliance) — attached initial summary (SOC2-type2-summary.pdf)
[ ] Joint: schedule KMS runbook + connectivity test (owner: Oliver / Rishi) — propose week of 2026-11-15; please confirm availability
[ ] Both: finalize MSA amendment language once legal signoffs complete (owner: Marissa)

Related links: HubSpot DEAL-4781 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4781) — please tag updates there so contracts and CSM are aligned.

If that looks correct, I'll ask Marissa to draft the amendment and circulate the redline. Thanks for the fast turnaround, and let me know if you'd prefer another quick sync before the KMS test.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v2.docx, SOC2-type2-summary.pdf, sample-audit-logs.txt

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
